sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Imagine you build an AI customer-support application.

Your primary model is hosted by Provider A.

At 10 AM, Provider A experiences an outage.

Your application receives:

```text
ConnectionError
Service Unavailable
Request Failed
```

Your application can no longer answer customer questions.

Customers see:

```text
Sorry, something went wrong.
Please try again later.
```

This is a provider availability problem, not necessarily an application-code problem.

steps.label: Symptom
steps.narration: Users or monitors report a visible failure signal.

steps.label: Detect
steps.narration: Correlate logs, metrics, and traces to identify the failure mode.

steps.label: Isolate
steps.narration: Contain blast radius so healthy traffic keeps working.

steps.label: Mitigate
steps.narration: Apply retries, fallbacks, degrade modes, or kill-switches.

steps.label: Recover
steps.narration: Fix the root cause, verify recovery, and capture a runbook update.
